simplevoicechat:title: Simple Voice Chat
simplevoicechat:tooltip-action-invite: Invite the player to this channel.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-channel-name: Edit the selected channel name; owner or administrator only.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-create-channel-n: Enter a name, then choose the channel type to create.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-drag-window: Drag the title bar to move the window.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-input-device: Choose the microphone used for voice chat. Default uses the system microphone; switching devices restarts capture.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-mic-gain: Adjust the microphone volume sent to other players. Increase it if your voice is too quiet; excessive gain may cause distortion.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-noise-gate: Reduce noise during quiet moments in push to talk, with a smooth release. In voice activation, this sets the minimum trigger level while preserving soft speech and word endings after activation. Set to 0 to disable the noise gate.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-noise-suppressio: Reduce steady background noise, such as fans. Unavailable when the noise suppression component cannot be loaded.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-occlusion: Let walls and obstacles reduce and muffle nearby players' voices. Cannot be disabled when required by the server.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-output-volume: Adjust the volume of players' voices you hear, with additional amplification above 100%. The game's master volume also applies. The playback device follows the game's settings.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-performance: Reduce wall checks and update environmental states less often to lower processing cost with many speakers, at the expense of effect accuracy and responsiveness.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-activation-mode: Push to talk sends voice while you hold the voice hotkey. Voice activation sends automatically when microphone volume reaches the trigger threshold.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-voice-trigger-th: Microphone level required to start sending in voice activation, at least as high as the noise gate. Raise it to reduce accidental activation, or lower it for softer speech. Short pauses are preserved after activation. Setting both this and the noise gate to 0 sends continuously.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-environmental-vo: Play underwater effects, cave reverb, and voice effects caused by masks and helmets. Effects depend on server rules.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-hide-self: Hide yourself from ordinary players' voice player lists. This does not stop voice transmission.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-reject-invites: Automatically decline voice channel invitations from other players. Enabling this also declines any pending invitation.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-hide-chat-messag: Hide routine mod notifications in chat. Channel invitations remain visible so you can respond to them.
simplevoicechat:tooltip-rename-channel: Save the selected channel's new name.
simplevoicechat:ui-admin-warning: Persistent actions are audited. Verify the target.
simplevoicechat:admin-config-help: Save and apply writes the server configuration and applies it immediately. Reload reads the server file; Refresh reads the active settings. Both replace unsaved edits. Equipment rules are managed in the server file.
